prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-23, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#732; borg-reborn-rs #1098, PR #1117 at 40c3bcc8: merged with track-p d3d1629f, which ships stair_scum (#1061); with the fixes of the owner review of #1117; the earlier pilot and verysmall at 3a2d2215 were on a previous build and do not carry over). Eight arms: ctl (shipped, explore_breadth_first 1 and explore_bfs_leave_when_done 1); cexit (explore_c_leave_when_done 1: C's own exploration takes the stairs once it finds nothing, before the secret-door search; locally secret-door searches 587 -> 78, mean CL at 100k 5.55 -> 5.20, one game stuck in a two-grid loop, #1130); bfs-stay (explore_bfs_leave_when_done 0, the old behaviour); mixed (explore_mixed 1); nobfs (explore_breadth_first 0, the control for mixed-alone); mixed-alone (explore_mixed 1, explore_breadth_first 0); mixed-tight (explore_mixed 1, explore_mix_contact_damage 8); mixed-loose (explore_mixed 1, explore_mix_contact_damage 3). Pilot, then verysmall (classes-1800 starts 1-45), then small-rest (46-90), each tier on the owner's word after the previous gate; if capacity is short ctl, bfs-stay, cexit and mixed first. Local direction on the 20 starts (before the merge with d3d1629f, stair_scum off): mean CL at 100k bfs-stay / ctl / mixed 5.10 / 5.55 / 5.35, deaths 0 / 1 / 1 (the same floating-eye game, #852). The owner expects survivability to rise sharply at CL5-6, so the mode may not pay for itself.
Tier pilot: classes-18, 100,000 turns, one binary, shipped settings plus each arm's overrides, borg-rs core, 100,000 turns, specimen 40c3bcc8. Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's values in params-core.json; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; stalls and wall timeouts apart; identical plays per arm. Report: all deaths and deaths at CL3-8 (the band the mode is for), paired by start against ctl (mixed-alone against nobfs), exact McNemar; the cost: CL at 25k / 50k / 100k turns, starts reaching DL3 and DL5 and their first turn there; deaths per 10,000 turns at each (CL, DL) from #718's turns_at_level_depth; a death report with screens (/death-report) for deaths in mixed or ctl. Descriptive (RULES 14).
